scope: Native local Blu-ray/directory payload, real Go/SQLite/filesystem and independent SDK using exclusive synthetic inputs; not NAS, production or complete new downloader-protocol verification

publication.root: real directory, not a directory symlink
publication.members: individual real symlinks with frozen parent nodes and child receipts
publication.cold_recovery: cancelled after a real child published; close/reopen application and retry; existing published inode reused

ownership.aggregate: actual target entry bytes/digest, not referent snapshot
ownership.proof: real directory root/nodes and known member entry plus ordinary referent proof
ownership.available_check: complete target tree and each referent
ownership.delete_check: only known remaining subset, no new/replaced entries or referent traversal

metadata.cold_recovery: real NFO written, managed-file SQL update aborted, durable write journal retained; close/reopen and run original scrape job; proof finalized and journal removed

external_boundary.provider_copy_is_not_softlink: real SDK copy counterexample now fails before ownership adoption

remaining: owned links in file-management UI and mode choice/browser verification
